dslRule:
<!id: org.eclipse.swt.graphics.FontMetrics.getAverageCharWidth>
<!description: Replace deprecated org.eclipse.swt.graphics.FontMetrics.getAverageCharWidth() with getAverageCharacterWidth(), adding an explicit cast to int.
This applies when the result of the call is immediately used in an int context.
Note: This cleanup is applicable only when the enclosing class's Java source level is 9 or higher.>
<!severity: WARNING>
<!tags: deprecated, java9>

$gcFontMetrics.getAverageCharWidth() :: sourceVersionGE(9)
=>
(int) $gcFontMetrics.getAverageCharacterWidth()
;;
summary: Replaces the deprecated `FontMetrics.getAverageCharWidth()` method call with `getAverageCharacterWidth()`, adding an explicit `(int)` cast. This rule applies when the method call is part of an expression evaluated to an `int`.

verification.message: Candidate DSL must contain only one rule and optional per-rule metadata; file metadata, includes, and embedded Java are not promotable
